data: {{Top}} {{Otheruses|unidentified species}} {{Conjecture}} {{Species |image=[[File:Unidentified-Long-Legged-Species.png]] |name=Unidentified long-legged species |designation=[[Sentience|Sentient]]{{Andor|Make It Stop}} |class=[[Reptile|Reptilian]]{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{AD|Disney+}} |subspecies= |races= |height= |length= |wingspan= |mass= |skincolor=[[Color|Blue]], gray, and pink |haircolor= |feathers= |eyecolor=Dark |distinctions=Long legs |lifespan= |origin= |habitat= |diet= |language= }} A [[Reptile|reptilian]] '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. ==Biology and appearance== This [[Reptile|reptilian]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|blue]] and pink skin covered in dark stripes, with long necks, large [[nose]]s, pointed [[ear]]s, and spindly [[limb]]s, including three-fingered hands and elongated legs. ==Species in the galaxy== Sometime between [[18 BBY]] and [[15 BBY]],{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-interview-stellan-skarsgard-elizabeth-dulau|text=Andor's Stellan Skarsgård and Elizabeth Dulau Break Down Luthen and Kleya}} states that [[Kleya Marki]] and [[Luthen Rael]] had known each other for 17 [[Standard year|years]] by the events of "[[Who Else Knows?]]" The episode occurs directly after "[[Make It Stop]]," which dates itself to [[1 BBY]]. Therefore, Marki and Rael's first meeting and Rael's subsequent defection occurred around the year [[18 BBY]]. "Make It Stop" establishes that the execution of the five civilians on a [[Unidentified planet (hill town)|planet]] takes place before the creation of the [[Axis network]], which "[[Coruscant: Whispers of Rebellion]]" states was founded a [[Standard decade|decade]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']] [[Andor Season 1|Season 1]], which takes place in [[5 BBY]] per the reasoning [[:Template:AndorDate|here]]. Therefore, the bombing must have occurred between 18 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and [[15 BBY]]. a member of this species was present on a [[Unidentified planet (hill town)|planet]] visited by the [[human]]s [[Luthen Rael]] and [[Kleya Marki]], witnessing the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Death penalty|execute]] a group of locals. ==Behind the scenes== The species made their debut in a flashback of the [[Make It Stop|tenth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], directed by [[Alonso Ruizpalacios]] and aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი გრძელფეხებიანი რასა }} [[Category:Reptilian sentient species]]
